title: Print Glossary Mechanism
description: Add glossary mechanism to print LaTeX stack: GlossaryDefine/Gls usage tracking, Term/Definition/Pages table at end via listofglossaries, replacing unused semioglossary register stub.
summary: Added the 20-term project glossary to Zwischenbericht mit Bestand (`\GlossaryDefine` in preamble, `\listofglossaries` in appendix with header "Verwendung im Bericht"). Fixed glossary row materialization in `semio-window.sty` to use the same leak-free register-list token pattern, so documents with `\maketableofcontents` no longer fail at `\listofglossaries`. Verified via ticket `verify.ts` and `mit-bestand/bericht` build.
